name: amberfader
description: Compact classic-style remote for YouTube Music running in Firefox

scripts.embedded:run: npm run embedded:build && uv run --extra gui --extra embedded python -m amberfader.embedded
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.ext:run: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist/extension --firefox-profile build/firefox-dev-profile --keep-profile-changes --profile-create-if-missing
scripts.ext:lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/extension
scripts.ext:package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/extension --artifacts-dir dist/web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest
